'''Lyonford''' was a former king of [[Saldaea]].

== History ==
He couldn't keep his temper if challenged. He was also known as a great monarch.
== Trivia ==
* Lyonford is named for Chris Lyford, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
